edits.find: 值得注意的是，项羽身边
那时荥阳之围还远未发生
edits.replace: 那时荥阳之围还没有发生
edits.reason: Review: '远未' quantifies an unsupported interval.

edits.find: the siege of Xingyang was still a long way off
edits.replace: the siege of Xingyang had not yet happened

edits.find: 我光着身子来，不收点钱连应酬的本钱都没有
edits.replace: 我光着身子来，不收钱就没有办事的用度
edits.reason: Review: '应酬' not in source; 資 = means/expenses.

edits.find: without gifts I have no means to cover my expenses
edits.replace: without taking gold I had nothing to work with

edits.find: 项王真正信得过的骨干，亚父、钟离眛、龙且、周殷
edits.replace: 项王身边的骨鲠之臣，亚父、钟离眛、龙且、周殷

edits.find: 项羽果然不再信钟离眛等人
edits.replace: 项羽果然对钟离眛等人起了疑心
edits.reason: Source: 意不信 (began to doubt), not stopped trusting.

edits.find: Xiang Yu duly stopped trusting Zhongli Mo and the rest
edits.replace: Xiang Yu did indeed begin to doubt Zhongli Mo and the rest

edits.find: 宴后他接过汉王送来的玉斗，扔在地上拔剑砍破
edits.replace: 宴后，亚父接过玉斗，放在地上，拔剑撞破
edits.reason: Review: he was 沛公 then, and the giver is not in the excerpt.

edits.find: 两人合谋算计过别人，也当面吵翻过。
edits.replace: 两人一起谋划过，也早有不合：鸿门宴上项王对他的示意默然不应，他事后骂出「豎子不足與謀」。

edits.find: The two had schemed against others together, and they had also quarreled to each other's faces.
edits.replace: The two had planned together, and they had also already disagreed: at Hongmen Xiang Yu met his signals with silence, and afterwards Fan Zeng called him a "boy not worth planning with".

edits.find: 同样几个字，一次用来换取信任，一次说在信任破裂之后。
edits.replace: 同样几个字，一次说在受质疑、去留还可商量的时候，结果被留下；一次说在信任破裂之后。
edits.reason: Review: do not attribute strategy to Chen Ping.

edits.find: handed the decision to the King of Han to judge, and he was kept and promoted.
edits.replace: left the decision to the King of Han while his position was still open, and he was kept and promoted.

edits.find: The same words, once used to buy trust, once said after trust had already broken.
edits.replace: The same words, once while his place was still open to discussion, and once after trust had already broken.

edits.find: After the feast he took the jade goblet the King of Han had sent him, threw it down,
edits.replace: After the feast he took the jade dipper, set it on the ground,
edits.reason: Review: giver not in excerpt and he was not yet King of Han; follow 置之地，拔劍撞而破之.

episode.action: 项羽身边韩信陈平范增先后离开；反间计使范增求去

sources.citation: 司马迁《史记》卷五十六《陈丞相世家》（维基文库本，2026-10-30 取回）

what.zh: 陈平投汉、受金指控、六出奇计都在这一篇，篇幅不长，可以从“陳平既多以金縱反間”读起。
what.en: Chen Ping's defection, the bribery charge and his later stratagems are all in this short chapter.

what.zh: 从项羽一方看荥阳之围前后：请和、急围、范增离去、纪信诳楚。
what.en: The siege of Xingyang seen from Xiang Yu's side, including Fan Zeng's departure.

what.zh: 英文百科条目，概述陈平一生，适合入门；不是一手材料。
what.en: An overview of Chen Ping's whole career; a starting point, not a primary source.

what.zh: 韩信怎样从项羽帐下的郎中变成汉军大将，“印刓敝”那段评语也在这里。
what.en: How Han Xin went from a junior officer under Xiang Yu to Han's general, including his verdict on Xiang Yu.
